mapper.select: select member_id from member order by member_id limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into telegram_channel(name, chat_id, enabled, created_at, updated_at) select #{name}, #{chatId}, 0, NOW(), NOW() where not exists (select 1 from telegram_channel where chat_id = #{chatId})
mapper.select:
select c.id, c.name, c.chat_id, c.enabled, c.created_at, c.updated_at, r.notice_types from telegram_channel c inner join robot_telegram_channel r on r.channel_id = c.id where r.typename = #{typename,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and c.enabled = 1 and r.enabled = 1
and r.notice_enabled = 1 and (
r.notice_types is null or r.notice_types = '' or find_in_set(#{noticeType}, r.notice_types) > 0 )
